name: a level run
describe: A run through levels in order: clear one and a portal takes everyone to the next; the last level, or a boss, ends it (one clock for the whole run).
pick: the players go through places in order and the game is over at the end of the last one
ends: the last level cleared (or its boss down), or everyone down

needs.why: the levels mechanic is the run

promise: A run goes through its levels in order and ends at the last one, won or lost, and plays again.
